title: Orac and LCM
description: Given a sequence of integers, construct a multiset of LCMs of all pairs of elements and compute the GCD of this multiset.
input_format: First line: integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100,000), the number of elements in the sequence. Second line: n integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 200,000).
output_format: Print a single integer: the GCD of the LCMs of all pairs of elements in the sequence.
expected_approach: Use the property that gcd(lcm(A,B), lcm(A,C)) = lcm(A, gcd(B,C)) to compute the result efficiently.

test_cases.explanation: The only pair is (1, 1), and lcm(1, 1) = 1, so the GCD is 1.
The LCMs of all pairs are: 120, 200, 240, 400, 800, 960. The GCD of these values is 40.
